description: Add a phase (work item) to a workflow's project plan. Phases are appended at the end of the existing list. If the workflow has no project plan yet, one is created automatically.

assignedAgentId.description: Optional agent ID to assign this phase to.

description.description: Optional longer description or acceptance criteria.

title.description: Phase title — short, actionable description of the work.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your configured workspace.

name: add_phase
